overview_description.description: Chronicle Labs is a blockchain infrastructure company that develops decentralized oracle and verifiable data solutions for digital asset ecosystems. The platform delivers transparent, cryptographically verifiable market data to decentralized finance (DeFi) applications and tokenized asset platforms. The company focuses on secure, reliable, and auditable data infrastructure, supporting institutions and developers building blockchain-based financial applications.

about_short_description.short_description: Chronicle Labs is a blockchain infrastructure company that provides decentralized oracle and data verification for tokenized assets.

product.name: Chronicle Protocol
product.description: A decentralized oracle network providing cost-efficient, verifiable data feeds on multiple blockchains to support DeFi and tokenized asset applications.

product.name: Scribe Oracle System
product.description: A gas-efficient oracle system using Schnorr signature aggregation to compress multiple validator signatures into a single onchain signature, reducing transaction costs.

product.name: ScribeOptimistic Oracle
product.description: An extension of Scribe that adds an optimistic update model with offchain signature verification and a challenge mechanism to further reduce gas costs on Layer 1 blockchains.

product.name: Verified Asset Oracle (VAO)
product.description: An oracle service providing real-time, tamper-proof attestations of offchain real-world assets to enable transparent and verifiable tokenized asset data onchain.

product.name: The Chronicle Dashboard
product.description: An onchain dashboard for monitoring, verifying, and subscribing to oracle data feeds and validator activity across multiple blockchains.

product.name: Chronicle Points
product.description: A community rewards program that incentivizes participation in the Chronicle ecosystem through point accrual tied to the SKY Protocol.
